data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004's 'intentional inefficiency / sub-optimal diversity' mechanism is itself not independent resilience: it concedes that fragmentation is the driver, but fragmentation can be purely superficial while a shared cause persists underneath (e.g., diverse protocol implementations all depending on one CA, DNS provider, or OS kernel). It therefore cannot distinguish truly independent failure modes from failures that merely appear uncorrelated until the shared substrate is revealed; it even admits a countercondition (physical-layer event ignoring software diversity) that breaks the mechanism, yet offers no replacement discriminator.
